requirements.statement: Each production expiry writer request runs one unarmed lease start pass at limit 64; a full pass queues one next request on the next driver step without waiting EXPIRY_SECONDS.
The production drain selects at most 64 due unarmed lease rows per call, including full blocked prefixes, and drains eligible rows on later driver steps without an in-call selection loop.

A non-full production lease pass with no backed-off rows keeps the ten-second expiry cadence; queued and failed requests never cause immediate duplicate or failed-request retries. A full selection whose inspection/backoff fails without progress also waits for the normal cadence.

A production lease pass that backs rows off continues on the next driver step even if non-full or releasing zero; the following empty pass stops continuation, so all-blocked rows are not retried before durable backoff and eligible rows behind blocked rows progress.
